messages:
support-liaison: Customer reported intermittent 403s starting ~23:10 UTC after scheduled KMS rekey. They say API keys that were valid before the window started rejecting calls. stacktrace/log snippet attached.
jonas-oncall: Can you paste the exact error? 403 from our edge or 403 from vault/KMS unwrap?
maria-devops: From initial look it's failing at unwrap: "KMS Decrypt: InvalidCiphertext" in the sidecar logs for their edge service.
support-liaison: Copying customer log:
```
2026-03-17T23:12:04Z sidecar[pid=22] ERROR unwrap failed: kms: decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertext
auth: request rejected status=403 key_id=alias/app/apikeys/2026-03
```
sam-eng: That usually means the rewrap used a different key material (new key id) and some persisted secrets were still wrapped with old CMK not available to the decrypt call in that environment.
alice-ops: Do we have a timeline of the KMS alias swap? Was it rotated to a new key id and old key scheduled for deletion immediately?
maria-devops: The rotation run at 23:05 UTC. Alias pointed to new key id right away; old key marked as pending-deletion but not yet destroyed. There was an automated rewrap job that should have re-encrypted all vault values but I see retries failing for some tenant namespaces.
jonas-oncall: Repro steps for us: try to unwrap one of their vault values using our vault-agent with the service account from their edge cluster. If it fails, capture KMS logs and the key id from the ciphertext header.
support-liaison: I asked customer for a sample ciphertext; they gave one. I ran unwrap against staging KMS account and got same InvalidCiphertext.
sam-eng: OK do this on prod vault box:
```
# check envelope key id in ciphertext
vault read -field=ciphertext secret/data/customerX | head -n1 | base64 --decode | hexdump -C | sed -n '1,1p'
# then try decrypt with kms client
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://cipher.bin --key-id alias/app/apikeys --region us-east-1
```
maria-devops: I ran decrypt with old key id and it succeeds. With new key id it fails — so some secrets weren't rewrapped. Looks like the rewrap job skipped pods with high open file descriptors (long running processes) because the API to patch envvars failed with EBUSY.
alice-ops: That would explain stale in-memory secrets. Those pods would still have env var set to old ciphertext and sidecar keeps trying to decrypt with new key leading to InvalidCiphertext (since ciphertext header references old key id not in decrypt call).
claire-csm: Customer asks: why did this happen after rotation? they said they rely on rolling restart during maintenance.
support-liaison: Short answer: rewrap was partial and some long-running processes kept old ciphertext; KMS alias swap made the default decrypt path try new key id for envelope—mismatch => 403 to API consumers.
jonas-oncall: Quick mitigations:
- ask customer to restart edge pods (hotfix) OR
- run a targeted rewrap of the specific vault paths encrypted with old key id and push new ciphertext (safer)
- if immediate, temporarily point alias back to old key id until rewrap completes
maria-devops: I strongly prefer not to flip alias back unless we must. Plan: perform targeted rewrap run for the tenant paths that failed, then ask customer to restart a single pod to pick up envvars. Scheduling rewrap now.
sam-eng: Add one more: invalidate the in-memory sidecar cache for that service if possible (POST /sidecar/invalidate) — that'll avoid full restart for some stacks.
alice-ops: On k8s we can do `kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-service -n tenant-x` as fallback.
support-liaison: Customer asked for repro steps to run locally — provided this snippet for them to validate before restart:
```
# check ciphertext header keyid
kubectl exec -n tenant-x deploy/edge-service -- env | grep CUSTOMER_API_KEY
# decode and inspect
echo "$CUSTOMER_API_KEY" | base64 -d | head -c 64 | hexdump -C
```
claire-csm: Customer agreed to targeted restart of 2 pods in each region.
maria-devops: Rewrap run started for path secret/data/customerX/apikeys. Will post progress. (rewrap job id=rewrap-20260317-01)
devops-bot: rewrap-20260317-01: started on agent-hosts-03. 0/624 paths migrated.
maria-devops: First batch done 150/624, no errors. Found 48 items with ciphertext header pointing to keyid `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/oldkey-123` — scheduled for manual verify.
jonas-oncall: For manual verify, use `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob` against old key id to confirm we can still decrypt; then re-encrypt with new key and write to vault.
support-liaison: After rewrap finished for the two problematic keys, customer restarted pods and reported API success. They saw no 403s afterwards.
sam-eng: Root cause summary (to add to ticket): automated rewrap skipped long-running processes' secrets and alias swap was applied immediately. Because ciphertext header still referenced old key material, decrypt attempts failed when alias/resolver logic assumed new key for envelope lookup.
alice-ops: Action items:
- add a pre-swap gating step to ensure rewrap job completes or alias swap is deferred
- improve rewrap job to detect in-use env secrets and surface them for manual migration
- add a sidecar endpoint to force env reload/invalidate for long-running processes
- docs update: rotation playbook with steps for tenants with long-lived processes
claire-csm: I'll follow up with customer monday with a summary and the short-term mitigation steps we took. Thanks team :hugging_face:
support-liaison: Closing loop with customer now. Will tag this ticket resolved but keep postmortem doc open until we ship the gating change.
jonas-oncall: I'll own the gating change PR. planning/ETA: small design + tests -> 1 week.
maria-devops: Linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation
support-liaison: Thanks all, marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
